name: Prime-Linked (פריים)
description: Rate tracks the Bank of Israel prime rate. Changes with every central bank decision.
notes: Bank of Israel limits prime-linked component to no more than 2/3 of total mortgage.

name: Fixed Unlinked (קל"צ — קבועה לא צמודה)
description: Fixed rate and fixed principal — not linked to CPI. Monthly payment stays constant throughout the loan.
notes: No regulatory cap on the fixed-unlinked component. Considered the most predictable track.

name: CPI-Linked Fixed (קצ"מ — קבועה צמודה מדד)
description: Fixed interest rate, but the outstanding principal is adjusted monthly according to the Consumer Price Index (CPI). Monthly payment rises with inflation.
notes: Bank of Israel limits CPI-linked component to no more than 2/3 of total mortgage.
